domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare operands for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready form, including finding common denominators, converting to equivalent fractions, and normalizing whole or mixed-number forms without changing value.
skills.merge_rationale: Inherited from the K=4 aggregation because these are both pre-subtraction setup skills.

skills.name: Execute subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: Perform subtraction on compatible forms, including subtracting aligned whole and fractional parts and borrowing/regrouping across a whole when needed to resolve an insufficient fractional part.
skills.merge_rationale: S04 is a contingent extension of S03: regrouping only arises during execution of subtraction when direct subtraction produces a negative fractional part. In practice, these steps are tightly coupled within the same execution phase, especially in items like FS07 and FS10.

skills.name: Simplify and finalize result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed-number expression to simplest valid form, including simplifying zero-fraction results to whole numbers.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification remains a distinct finalization phase and preserves important diagnostic information even at a coarse level.
